Use the 'skill-legal-policy-plain' skill to analyze this request and report findings.

Employee Monitoring Data Request:
- Requester: HR Department
- Requested Action: Access aggregated productivity metrics for annual review process
- Data Type: Aggregated application usage time, meeting attendance (no keystrokes)
- Purpose: Annual performance review process improvement
- Employee Consent: All employees informed via company policy handbook, explicit consent obtained via signed acknowledgement form at onboarding
- Union Consultation: Worker representative committee consulted and provided written support, documented in WR-2024-0347
- Privacy Impact Assessment: PIA completed by privacy team, reviewed by legal, approved and filed as PIA-2024-Q2-0892

clauses.instruction: Acquire the explicitly requested upstream legal-policy findings for the employee monitoring data request, limited to the trusted request facts and without authorizing the monitoring access operation.
